scripts.text:
[Mariner]
This ship
is heading
towards ^666699Izlude^000000.
Have you enjoyed your time in Jawaii? You should check to see
if you forgot anything before we go.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
這艘船將駛往^666699依斯魯得島^000000。
您在爪哇玩得開心嗎？出發前，請檢查一下有沒有落下東西。

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Well, then.
Would you like
to go back to Izlude?
scripts.translation:
[水手]
那麼，您想回到依斯魯得島嗎？

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Now, let me
guide you to
Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
現在，讓我帶您去依斯魯得島。

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Take your time
and look around as
much as you like.
Somehow,  this is not
a place that you can
visit often, you know?
scripts.translation:
[水手]
慢慢逛，盡情遊覽吧。
畢竟，這裡可不是想來就能常來的地方。

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
This ship
is headed back
towards ^003399Alberta^000000.
Have you enjoyed your time in Jawaii? You should check to see
if you forgot anything before we go.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
這艘船將返回^003399艾爾貝塔^000000。
您在爪哇玩得開心嗎？出發前，請檢查一下有沒有落下東西。

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Now, are you
ready to go back
to Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[水手]
那麼，您準備好回到艾爾貝塔了嗎？

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Now, let me
take you back
to Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
現在，讓我帶您回艾爾貝塔。

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Yeah...
Try to enjoy your
vacation as much
as you can. We'll be
ready to leave when
you are.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
嗯...盡情享受假期吧。
您什麼時候準備好了，我們就什麼時候出發。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Oh, dear!
You're not going
to the tavern, are you?
scripts.translation:
[女士]
哎呀！
您不會是要去酒館吧？

scripts.text: No, I am not.
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text: Hell yeah~
scripts.translation: 當然要去~

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Whew~!
Thank goodness!
It's just that...
The tavern probably
isn't the best place for
you to enjoy yourself.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
呼~！謝天謝地！
只是...那家酒館恐怕不是個適合盡興的地方。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Even though I work there, I still can't believe that kind of place exists! I mean, I thought alcohol was outlawed in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
雖然我在那裡工作，還是不敢相信竟然會有那種地方！
我還以為盧恩·米德加茲王國禁酒呢！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
I have no idea how singles are
able to find this place. But I've heard that lots of different people come here for different reasons.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
真不知道那些單身的人是怎麼找到這裡的。
聽說來這裡的人形形色色，各有各的原因。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
I've even seen unmarried single people coming here just to get drunk! Oh! And for some reason, people have been disappearing
from the tavern!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
我甚至見過單身的人專程來這裡買醉！
哦！而且不知怎麼回事，還有人在酒館裡失蹤了！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
I wonder what's going on?
^666666*Sigh*^000000 I'm a waitress there, but still I just want to tell you not to go in there...
scripts.translation:
[女士]
那裡到底出了什麼事呢？
^666666*嘆氣*^000000 雖然我是那裡的女服務員，還是想勸您別進去...

scripts.text:
[Jawa Jawa]
You know what's
the most beautiful
place in Jawaii?
scripts.translation:
[爪哇爪哇]
您知道爪哇最美的地方是哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jawa Jawa]
It's 'Heart Island,' which is just a little north of here. The water surrounding Heart Island is not that deep, so you can just walk across if you're careful.
scripts.translation:
[爪哇爪哇]
是“心之島”，就在我們北邊不遠處。心之島周圍的水不深，只要小心一點，您可以直接走過去。

scripts.text:
[Jawa Jawa]
That's the best place to share an intimate moment with the person
you love. It's perfectly secluded and such a beautiful area.
scripts.translation:
[爪哇爪哇]
那是與您所愛之人共享親密時刻的最佳地點。那裡非常隱蔽，景色也很美。

scripts.text:
[Jawa Jawa]
Of course, it's probably not
a good idea to go there by
yourself if you're single.
You'd look like such
a pathetic loser!
scripts.translation:
[爪哇爪哇]
當然，單身的話，最好別一個人去。
看起來會像個可憐的失意者！

scripts.text:
[Waii Waii]
Welcome to Jawaii!
scripts.translation:
[懷懷]
歡迎來到爪哇！

scripts.text:
[Waii Waii]
Here, you can enjoy your
honeymoon without worrying about any interruptions. You don't even have to bother with that notorious Single Army!
scripts.translation:
[懷懷]
在這裡，您可以安心享受蜜月，不用擔心被打擾。您甚至不用理會那個臭名昭著的單身軍團！

scripts.text:
[Waii Waii]
Well, there are a few monsters around, but you'll be okay as long as you don't attack them first. Think of them as the original residents of this island, another sight to enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[懷懷]
嗯，周圍有一些魔物，但只要您不先攻擊它們，就沒關係。把它們當作這座島的原住民，也是這裡的一道風景吧。

scripts.text:
[Waja Waja]
Ah, you must be a tourist.
If you're lost, just head West. Accommodations for newlyweds
are located in the western part of Jawaii. The lodging here is
pretty amazing.
scripts.translation:
[瓦賈瓦賈]
啊，您是遊客吧。
迷路的話，就往西走。爪哇西邊有專供新婚夫婦入住的客房，條件相當不錯。

scripts.text:
[Waja Waja]
There are four different themed rooms, so you can choose one to your liking. There's a Guide around if you want to ask for more information.
scripts.translation:
[瓦賈瓦賈]
這裡有四種不同主題的客房，您可以選擇自己喜歡的。如果您想了解更多資訊，附近有一位嚮導。

scripts.text:
[Waja Waja]
When you want to go back, please head to the NorthWest to board
a ship to Alberta. If you want to sail to Izlude, there's a ship waiting in the SouthEast.
scripts.translation:
[瓦賈瓦賈]
當您想回去時，請前往西北方搭乘前往艾爾貝塔的船。如果您想前往依斯魯得島，東南方有一艘船在等待。

scripts.text:
[Iwa Iwa]
Jawaii~
Jawa~ii~
Where you can
find happiness~
scripts.translation:
[伊瓦伊瓦]
爪哇~
爪~哇~
幸福就在這裡~

scripts.text:
[Iwa Iwa]
Oh, isn't it beautiful? You don't have to do anything other than relax and breathe in the peaceful atmosphere. That's one of the
best things about Jawaii.
scripts.translation:
[伊瓦伊瓦]
哦，這裡美不美？您只需要放鬆身心，呼吸這寧靜的空氣。這就是爪哇最棒的地方之一。

scripts.text:
[Iwa Iwa]
Ooh! Sometimes we hold
concerts on this stage. If you're good at singing, why don't you
go up on stage and sing
a song for us?
scripts.translation:
[伊瓦伊瓦]
噢！有時候我們會在這個舞臺上舉辦音樂會。如果您擅長唱歌，何不走上舞臺為我們唱首歌呢？

scripts.text:
[Iwa Iwa]
Jawaii~
Jawa~ii~
Where you can
find happiness~
scripts.translation:
[伊瓦伊瓦]
爪哇~
爪~哇~
幸福就在這裡~

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
W-Welcome...?
This is o-o-our
s-sweet room.
We, we just c-cleaned
this r-room for you
o-of course.
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
歡...歡迎...？
這...這是我們的甜...甜蜜房。
當...當然，我...我們剛替您打...打掃過了。

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
Th-The charge is is
1000 zeny p-p-per person?
P-please pay me the fee and
I,I'll let you in. I ssss...swear!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
費...費用是每人1000 Zeny？
請...請先付錢，我...我就讓您進去。
我...我發誓！

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
I, I'll also ca-carry your luggage. B-but pay me first. Otherwise, my bo-boss will be unhappy and... ^666666*Gulp*^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
我...我也會幫您搬行李。
但...但得先付錢。不然，老...老闆會不高興，然後...^666666*咽口水*^000000

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
^333333Beat me to death...^000000
Use.
scripts.translation: 入住

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
T-Thank you ssso much!
L-Let open the room door
ffffor you. Thank y-you.
Ha-have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
太...太感謝您了！
我...我這就替您開...開門。謝...謝謝。
祝...祝您玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
Oh no! Oh no no no no no.
Th-This isn't enough money?
I-I'm ssssorry, but my b-boss w-will beat me if I l-let you
in without paying...
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
糟了！不不不，糟了！
這...這些錢不夠？
對...對不起，不付錢就讓您進去，老...老闆會打我的...

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
^666666*Sniff*^000000
B-but I promise th-that this room is the nicest and cl-cleanest room! P-Please! C-come back!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
^666666*抽泣*^000000
但...但我保證這間房是最漂亮、最...最乾淨的房間！請...請回來吧！

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
Welcome to
the Antique room.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奧蘭]
歡迎來到古董主題房。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
This room provides lovers with
an atmosphere of plush elegance.
Every comfort is provided for
young couples in this room.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奧蘭]
這間客房奢華優雅，為年輕情侶提供舒適周到的住宿體驗。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
All the rooms may have the same basic structure, but each of them has their own unique interior to suit the tastes of different people.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奧蘭]
雖然所有房間的基本結構都相同，但每間房都有獨特的內部裝飾，以迎合不同人的品味。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
If you would like to lodge here, it is required to pay a 1,000 zeny fee for each person before entering. Since you're here to make fond memories of your honeymoon,
you should stay in the nicest room.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奧蘭]
如果您想在此住宿，進入前每人需支付1,000 Zeny的費用。
既然您是來度過蜜月、創造美好回憶的，就應該選擇最漂亮的房間。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
Do not hesitate to let me know when you've decided on the Antique Room. Once you've made your choice,
I will guide you there.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奧蘭]
決定入住古董主題房的話，隨時告訴我。
選好後，我會帶您過去。

scripts.text: Use.
scripts.translation: 入住

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
Thank you
for using
our services.
Please...
Make yourself
comfortable.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奧蘭]
感謝您使用我們的服務。
請...安心休息，祝您住得舒適。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
I am sorry, but you don't seem to have enough money. If it's alright, why don't you check your current funds and see what you can do
about this situation?
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奧蘭]
很抱歉，您的錢似乎不夠。
方便的話，請確認一下手頭的錢，看看能不能想想辦法。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
Please...
Take your time.
There should be no rush
when it comes to leisure.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奧蘭]
請...慢慢來。
享受閒暇，不必著急。

scripts.text:
[Sharkie Rania]
I'll take you
to the Honey Room.
It costs 1,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[沙基·拉尼婭]
我帶你去蜂蜜主題房，費用是1,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Sharkie Rania]
So you wanna go?
scripts.translation:
[沙基·拉尼婭]
怎麼樣，要去嗎？

scripts.text: Use.
scripts.translation: 入住

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Sharkie Rania]
Eh, alright.
Let's get going.
scripts.translation:
[沙基·拉尼婭]
嗯，好吧。
我們出發吧。

scripts.text:
[Sharkie Rania]
You...
Don't have
enough money.
C'mon, romance
takes zeny, got it?
scripts.translation:
[沙基·拉尼婭]
你...錢不夠。
拜託，浪漫也要花Zeny的，懂嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sharkie Rania]
No prob.
scripts.translation:
[沙基·拉尼婭]
沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
Hello dear,
how are you?
Are you looking for
a room to stay in?
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼婭]
你好，親愛的，最近怎麼樣？
你是在找住的地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
This is called the Villa Room.
I recommend this room to people
who prefer to stay in a place with
a comfortable atmosphere
much like home.
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼婭]
這是別墅主題房。
想住得像在家一樣溫馨舒適，我推薦你選這間。

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
Just like all the other rooms,
the lodging charge is 1,000 zeny.
I can guide you to the Villa Room
right now, if you wish. Would you
like to stay?
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼婭]
和其他客房一樣，住宿費是1,000 Zeny。
願意的話，我現在就能帶您去別墅主題房。
您要入住嗎？

scripts.text: Use.
scripts.translation: 入住

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
Thank you~
Enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼婭]
謝謝~
祝您住得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
Oh what a shame!
You don't seem
to have enough money...?
Why don't you ask your
partner to help you
with the charge?
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼婭]
真遺憾！您的錢似乎不夠...？
不如請伴侶幫忙付一下房費？

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
No problem~
If you like, you may wish to check the Honey Room. Although the roomkeeper, Sharkie, is a shy girl, the room is really beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼婭]
沒問題~
如果您喜歡，也可以去看看蜂蜜主題房。雖然房間管理員沙基是個害羞的女孩，但那間房真的很漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
There is no place
better for having your
honeymoon than Jawaii.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
沒有比爪哇更適合度蜜月的地方了。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Why don't you make the best of your time here, and make a lot of sweet memories that you will cherish for years to come?
scripts.translation:
[助手]
何不盡情享受這裡的時光，留下值得珍藏一生的甜蜜回憶？

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Mementos that remind you of your happy times can be your most precious possessions. Like your wedding ring, for instance, or the tuxedo and wedding dress worn during your wedding ceremony...
scripts.translation:
[助手]
能讓您想起幸福時光的紀念品，往往最值得珍惜。
比如結婚戒指，或婚禮上穿的燕尾服和結婚禮服...

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Even if the wedding ceremony
is over, isn't it nice to look back upon the happy memories of your marriage ceremony? With the magical photo album at a cheap price, now you can!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
婚禮雖然結束了，能重溫當時的幸福回憶，不也很美好嗎？
現在，只要花一點錢買本魔法相簿，就能做到！

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Its name is...
'Sweet Memory of Marriage'!!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
它的名字是...
“甜蜜婚憶”！！

scripts.text:
[Helper]
It will instantly bring you to the wedding hall with magic power!
And it only costs 50,000 zeny...
scripts.translation:
[助手]
它能通過魔力瞬間將您傳送到婚禮大廳！
而且只需要50,000 Zeny...

scripts.text: I shall buy it.
scripts.translation: 我要買

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Thank you very much~!
Please remember, you
should use this with your
partner in a place that is
special to the both of you.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
非常感謝~！
記得和伴侶一起，在對你們兩人有特殊意義的地方使用哦。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
'Sweet Memory of Marriage' is 50,000 zeny. But don't seem to have enough money with you right now. Maybe you and your partner could help each other to buy the Sweet Memory of Marriage?
scripts.translation:
[助手]
“甜蜜婚憶”售價50,000 Zeny。但您似乎手頭資金不足。也許您可以和您的伴侶一起湊錢購買“甜蜜婚憶”呢？

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Even if your relationship ends,
the memories the both of you have shared will remain forever...
scripts.translation:
[助手]
即使感情走到了盡頭，你們共同的回憶也會永遠留存...

scripts.text:
[Employee Tryteh]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
Anyway, I am so glad that you two have gotten married. I hope you both will live happily ever after~
scripts.translation:
[員工 特萊泰]
歡迎來到爪哇酒館~
真為你們喜結連理感到高興。願你們永遠幸福~

scripts.text:
[Employee Tryteh]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
I hope you enjoy your stay
over here. But try not
to drink too much~
scripts.translation:
[員工 特萊泰]
歡迎來到爪哇酒館~
希望你們在這裡度過愉快的時光。但請儘量不要喝太多~

scripts.text:
[Employee Tryteh]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
I hope you will have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[員工 特萊泰]
歡迎來到爪哇酒館~
希望你們玩得開心。

scripts.text:
[Employee Tryteh]
Try to be a little careful if you bump into any rude customers.
They might be drunk and do something stupid. You know
how it is...
scripts.translation:
[員工 特萊泰]
如果遇到粗魯的顧客，請小心一點。
他們可能喝醉了，會做出傻事。你知道的...

scripts.text:
[Employee Fey]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
scripts.translation:
[員工 菲伊]
歡迎來到爪哇酒館~

scripts.text:
[Employee Fey]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
Have a good time! But please,
try not to interrupt the happily married people here!
scripts.translation:
[員工 菲伊]
歡迎來到爪哇酒館~
祝你玩得開心！不過，請別打擾這裡的幸福夫妻哦！

scripts.text:
[Employee Fey]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
I hope you will have a good time~
scripts.translation:
[員工 菲伊]
歡迎來到爪哇酒館~
希望你們玩得開心~

scripts.text:
[Employee Fey]
We hope that you enjoy your time here with the one that you love. Isn't this place nice and cozy,
a perfect romantic atmosphere?
scripts.translation:
[員工 菲伊]
希望你能在這裡和愛人共度美好時光。
這裡溫馨又舒適，是不是很浪漫？

scripts.text:
[Employee Fey]
It would be absolutely perfect if it weren't for those 'Invincible Single Army' weirdos. Somehow,
a few of those dorks found their way here. To hell with them!
scripts.translation:
[員工 菲伊]
